recipe.visualDefinition: A low-fidelity, sepia-tinted urban scene featuring a group of men in streetwear posed on a concrete staircase, characterized by a heavy yellow-gold color cast and high-contrast shadows typical of early 1990s rap photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic sepia tint unifying subjects and background
Oval-framed display text at the top left providing a visual anchor
Staircase geometry creating a diagonal upward movement
High-contrast lighting emphasizing folds in oversized clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five figures distributed across the vertical plane of a staircase, occupying the middle and foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large purple oval with stylized white lettering in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, follows the diagonal line of the stairs down through the figures, ending at the bottom-right advisory badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with architectural details and figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Golden-yellow sepia tint across the entire photographic plate.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep purple for the primary logo background and bright lime green for the promotional sticker.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in highlights with low saturation, except for the graphic overlays which use flat, saturated colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended bold sans-serif and slab-serif hybrids.
letterConstructionRules: Internal decorative cutouts or inline effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters within the oval are stretched horizontally to fill the elliptical space
Bottom text features wide tracking and a blocky, digital-inspired sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact display type for the brand name paired with widely-spaced geometric sans for secondary information.

preserve: Horizontal stretching of the main logo
Wide tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, blocky 90s tech-urban feel of the secondary text.
Provides the heavy slab-serif foundation for the main logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, low-resolution photograph of five men in 90s streetwear (beanies, oversized coats, sunglasses) sitting and standing on a concrete staircase in front of an urban building. Apply a heavy, monochromatic yellow-gold sepia tint and high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large purple oval in the top left with white horizontally-stretched slab-serif text. Add a lime green circle on the left middle with black sans-serif text. Place a small white-bordered black rectangle with 'ADVISORY' style text in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main logo contained in a purple oval?
Is the secondary text at the bottom widely tracked?
Does the scene feel like a 90s urban environment?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures on the stairs
Degree of horizontal stretch on the main logo
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the promotional sticker
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple oval is present and prominent.
Check that the sepia tint covers the entire background and subjects.
Verify the wide tracking on the bottom text.
Confirm the presence of a high-contrast 'Advisory' style badge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban photography + Monochromatic Sepia Tint + Stretched Slab-Serif Logo in Oval + Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans Footer.
